# Techathos

> Techathos builds fast websites and AI automation for small and growing businesses. Founded by Dennis Merenguelli and based in Connecticut, we work remotely with clients nationwide. First consultation is free.

- Website: https://techathos.com/

- Founder: Dennis Merenguelli (https://www.linkedin.com/in/dennis-merenguelli/)

## Services

- **Website Development**: Custom, mobile-first sites built from scratch — no bloated page builders, no cookie-cutter templates. Landing pages and business sites, e-commerce on Shopify or WooCommerce, and fast load times.
- **AI Automation**: Agents and workflows that answer leads, book calls and update your CRM while you sleep: 24/7 AI chat and voice agents, lead routing and follow-up, and custom GPT assistants.
- **E-Commerce Builds**: Storefronts with secure checkout, payments, shipping and tax configured from day one, including product and catalog setup and abandoned-cart recovery.
- **SEO Foundations**: Keyword research, page titles, meta tags, Google Business Profile and Search Console setup, local business schema, FAQ markup and analytics dashboards.
- **Custom Integrations**: Online booking, payment links, CRM and email-list connections added to a new or existing site, including Calendly and booking flows, CRM and email sync, and API and webhook work.
- **Social Media Management**: Consistent, on-brand posting, community management and short-form video, with content calendars, graphics and captions, and a monthly strategy call.

## Pricing

Prices are the current launch rate, 50% off the standard rate shown in parentheses. Every project is scoped and given a fixed quote after a short discovery call.

### Website Development

- Landing Page: $375–$750 (standard $750–$1,500). A single, mobile-first page built to capture leads for a launch, promotion or event.
- Business Website: $1,250–$2,500 (standard $2,500–$5,000). 5–7 custom pages with contact forms, maps and on-page SEO, built so you can easily update it.
- E-Commerce Store: $2,000–$4,500 (standard $4,000–$9,000). A Shopify or WooCommerce store with product setup, secure checkout, payments and shipping.
- Website Redesign: $1,000–$2,750 (standard $2,000–$5,500). Modernize an outdated site with a fresh look, faster load times and clearer calls to action.
- SEO Foundations: $300–$600 (standard $600–$1,200). Keyword research, page titles and meta tags, Google Business Profile and Search Console setup.
- Custom Integrations: $250–$1,000 (standard $500–$2,000). Online booking, payment links, CRM and email-list hooks added to a new or existing site.

### AI Automation Packages

- AI Kickstart: $500–$1,250 setup (standard $1,000–$2,500). One AI agent or workflow, live on your site and connected to your inbox.

- AI Care Plan: $200–$600 per month (standard $400–$1,200). Monitoring, prompt tuning, new workflows and a monthly performance review.

## FAQ

**Why are your prices 50% off right now?**
We are filling our build calendar for the quarter, so every package on this page is discounted 50% from our standard rate. The scope, quality and support are identical — you just lock in launch pricing.

**How fast can my website be live?**
Bronze builds go live in about 3 business days, Silver in about 7 and Gold in about 14, counted from the moment we have your logo, photos and basic business details.

**What does “SEO built in” actually mean?**
Every page ships with a unique title and description, local business markup, FAQ markup where it fits, fast mobile pages, a sitemap, and Google Analytics and Search Console connected on day one.

**Do I own my website?**
Yes. You own your domain, your content and your photos. Hosting and ongoing updates are included for 6 months, then just $17.50 a month with no long contract.

**What exactly is AI automation?**
Software agents and workflows that handle the repetitive parts of your business — answering chats, qualifying leads, booking calls, sending follow-ups and updating your CRM — 24/7, without you hiring more staff.

**Can you work with my existing site?**
Absolutely. We regularly add AI agents, booking, payment links and CRM integrations to sites we did not build, and we modernize outdated designs without losing your search rankings.

**How do we get started?**
Send your project details through the contact form or book a call. Your first consultation is free, and we reply the same business day.
